description: Inputs to data/local_models.json, the sizing data behind /local. Nothing here feeds the composite or any rank.

selection.eligible: scored models whose accessibility is open weights
selection.match: exact equality of the normalised model name (namespace before the slash ignored)
selection.among_candidates: most downloaded repo; ties broken by repo name
selection.note: The rule reads no publisher. It is mechanical, so it can pick a repack over the original; candidates and size_disagreement are published per row.

attention_layouts.description: Hybrid models mix full-attention layers, whose KV cache grows with context, with linear or state-space layers that keep a fixed-size state. Only the full layers are charged for context. A layout is a ratio; it is scaled to the model's real layer count when sizing.
attention_layouts.limit: Only the families llmfit lists have a layout. Any other hybrid, and any model with no match here, is sized as all full attention, which over-states its memory. Add a rule by pull request with the model's own config as evidence.
